replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: Here you go Murph-- - https://www.dropbox.com/s/tpak1apcwugkoux/Camelot.zip?dl=0--Few things - You are using some 1.8 + blocks so a mapdev will need to tell us if the map is compatible at this time. Also the map was built in 1.8.1 so Items may not carry over to a 1.7.10 server.--The last thing  - You will have to color code the other quads as all the quads sport the same colors. lastly You may want to check the number  of Cows / chickens etc...--Other than that - The Map is really well made. I think it is your best yet. -Great Job

replies.author: Dyspa
replies.body: +1 The map looks simple but it still looks good, I like how you made the walls and the details you added all over the map, however, I think you didn't put too much effort in this map and it looks a bit rushed aswell, the castle uses almost all the area so I suggest you to add something in the mines or reduce the castle a bit so the map has more features to explore.
